digest.component_or_area: container plan-review attestation and file-impact scope inheritance
propositions: A live child declared `none` is neutral in drift-scope inheritance and does not poison sibling path declarations
A live child declared `undeclared` poisons child inheritance, preventing all children paths from being inherited and blocking all-none classification
Container scope precedence: own/cited/inherited paths yield `paths`; explicit parent `none` yields `none`; all live children `none` promotes undeclared parent to `none`; otherwise `unscoped`
Plan-review signing must compute child impact once and use it consistently for dependency hashing and all-none classification via the tri-state scope precedence rule
Cheap resign must preserve the same child-derived signed scope from the immutable relation snapshot without network reads
P9 validation passes containers whose live children are all declared, advises only live undeclared children as poisoners, and names both path declaration and `--none` as truthful remedies
